resources.string: Add lock shortcut to Home screen
1. Tap “Add lock shortcut” above, or long-press the QuickLock lock icon in the app drawer and choose “Add to Home screen”.
1. Long-press the QuickLock lock icon in the app drawer and choose “Add to Home screen”.
2. Drag the icon into the Dock, or anywhere on the Home screen.
3. Tap it once — the screen locks immediately. The app does not open.
4. HyperOS path for the permission: Settings → Additional settings → Accessibility → Downloaded apps → QuickLock.
If the QuickLock switch is greyed out: open App info → ⋮ → “Allow restricted settings” (Android 13+ requirement for apps installed outside the Play Store), then try again.
No internet permission. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
QuickLock needs its accessibility service. Enable it once in settings.
This launcher cannot pin shortcuts. Drag the QuickLock lock icon from the app drawer instead.
Lets QuickLock turn the screen off and lock it when you tap the QuickLock icon. It does not read screen content, text or input events.
